Question 2
?

Let f(x,y,z) be a function that is differentiable at each point on the line segment AB―, where a=⟨−1,−1,3⟩ and b=⟨3,0,−2⟩ are the position vectors of A and B, respectively. If f(a)=5 and f(b)=−1, then what is missing from the statement below?

The mean value theorem states that there exists a point C∈AB― with position vector c such that |_______________.

a
4fx(c)−3fy(c)−2fz(c)=−4
b
4fx(c)+fy(c)−5fz(c)=−6
c
fx(c)−fy(c)+fz(c)=−8
d
3fx(c)+2fy(c)−fz(c)=6
e
2fx(c)−4fy(c)−3fz(c)=4
Submit
